Messages.Author: Eric
Messages.Body:
Rafastio Ghoul [FN]
Cardtype: Ally

Cost: 3 pool

Ghoul with 2 life. 1 bleed, 1 strength.
Rafastio Ghoul can play cards requiring basic Thaumaturgy [tha] as a vampire
with a capacity of 3. Any cost in blood is paid with his life. If a card
would give him blood, give him life instead.

Q: Does the Rafastio Ghoul act like a vampire? Can he/she play cards that
require a vampire? (like a Master Skill card; Thaumaturgy)

Thanks!

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


The Ghoul can play cards that require basic thaumaturgy as a vampire.

Messages.Author: hamdamcwa
Messages.Body:
> > > Q: Does the Rafastio Ghoul act like a vampire? Can he/she play cards
> that
> > > require a vampire? (like a Master Skill card; Thaumaturgy)
> >
> > The Ghoul can play cards that require basic thaumaturgy as a vampire.

In case you can't get what LSJ has said here, yes they can play
Thaumaturgy cards as if they were a vampire, but no you can't give
them a Thaumaturgy skillcard so they can play the superior level of
Thaumaturgy cards.

Skillcards only go on Vampires, not allies.

> I suppose the Rasta Ghoul could play a Router Hand then? And go to torpor
> afterwards? Wacky I tellz ya!

Sure, but you might as well just burn the ally, since there's no way
of rescuing it (no dynamic for rescuing allies in torpor).

DH
